Short title and extent

FINANCE ACT, 2003
FINANCE ACT, 2003
ACT I OF 2003
An act to give
effect to the financial proposals of the Federal Government for the year
beginning on the first day of July, 2003, and to amend certain laws
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
17,th June, 2003]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President ion the 16th
June, 2003, and is hereby published for general information:--
It is hereby enacted as
follows:--
1. Short title and
extent.------(1) This Act may be called the Finance Act, 2003.
(2) It extends to the whole of
Pakistan.
